تستأنوا (form X)
# تَسْتَأْنُوا (tastaʔnū) /tas.taʔ.nuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَأْنَى (istaʔnā)
# تُسْتَأْنَوْا (tustaʔnaw) /tus.taʔ.naw/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَأْنَى (istaʔnā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
